lines: Leticia's voice lines and sound effects.
- "Quincy, you got plans tonight? Civvie operative might need oversight. SDR picked up a tail. Could be something, could be nothing."
- "Aoi, when you got a minute, I need a few simple tools fabricated. Nothing major."
- "Need to get something off your chest?"
- "We're all just visiting; we own nothing. Civilization isn't a home; it's a hostel. Some previous guests were better than others. Tomorrow night a stranger will be sleeping in that bed."

- "In a former life my job was to sew screaming meat back together in warzones. Day in day out. People got weird, burned out. But compared to this it was like having my hair braided at a music festival."
- "If you ever wonder why you're in a situation like this, then you've forgotten just how contagious cruelty is."
- "No hay tos (No problem (slang)), I got a minute."
- "Más basura vieja (More old trash), friend? Got more old junk for us?"
- "¡Que chido! (That's great (slang)) Makin' friends wherever we go, aren't we?"
- "No problema (No problem). This is a good thing."
- "Ay, huele feo (smells bad)... did you find this on, near or in something that died? Ugh. We can use it, though. Unfortunately."
- "¡Ay, que bueno! (Oh, excellent!) You have just made someone very happy."
- "¡Madres! ((A slang exclamation, used to emphasise other statements)) ¡Muy bien! (Very good!) Nice."
- "Fine. Waste my time. Te lo juro por mi madre (I swear by my mother)..."
- "Ay, pobrecito (Oh, poor thing). Come back when you got something worth my time. Okay?"
- "Okay. Primerito (First): don't waste my time. Segundo? (Second?) Do. Not. Waste. My time."
- "Ahí luego nos vemos (See you around (literally 'see you there later') (informal))."
- "Vigila tu espalda ahí fuera (Watch your back out there). Eyes open, friend."
- "Buena suerte (Good luck). Bring back something nice."
- "¡Órale! A ver (Alright! Let's see). Whatchu got."
- "Te ves bien (You look good), my friend."
- "Hm? You're either very drunk or very brave. Either way… You sure?"
- "OOokay… But we're gonna talk about this in private, yeah? Before you get in over your head… Now go - I'm busy - And you're making me blush."
- "On, off, on, off, make up your damn mind, Drool."
- "After what you said? Get the hell away from me."
- "I want you to be real sure of the next words to come out of your face, Drool… you do not get a second chance with me."
- "Fine. You done? I'm busy. Get lost."
- "Ff- Get lost, you stupid… little… - get out of my face."
- "I will do you a favor then, and pretend this moment of stupidity never happened, yeah? Now go. I'm busy."
- "Te ves bien, mi amor (You look good, my love)."
- "I gotta get outta here and get some clarity. ¿Me entiendes? (Understand me?) Whatever it takes."
- "Later. You and me. Percussive maintenance. Now, what do you need?"
- "Ah. We're talking shop. Okay. No worries. But later, you want something, I don't want you asking. Read me?"
- "Hey. Try not to get that ass beat? I like it as it is."
- "Clocking off in a minute. See you back home."
- "Hit me up if you wanna take a run at something. Got me some steam needs releasing."
- "Always a relief to see you back in one piece. Not sure I'll ever get comfortable worrying about someone."
- "If I didn't have you to talk to, Sol knows where I'd be. Amir's a boy, Quincy's a thundercloud and Arthur swishes around like Alexander the Great. Rats are better conversation."
- "Hey, have you seen Vaquero anywhere? That little bastard always gets into the weirdest of places in here..."
- "All limbs intact? No extra holes? Good. Nobody gets to see you break a sweat except me."
- "What, were you expecting dinner? Fat chance."
- "Ugh. Being bored is worse than being overworked."
- "That mutant cat is staring at my little muffins again... if she makes one wrong move, I get a new leather coat."
- "It's quiet here. I can at least hear myself think."
- "Ay, would it kill you to get a comfy place to sit in here, sunshine?"
- "Next time you're out, come back with some treats for Anita, she learned a new trick. It's the cutest thing."
- "Ugh. I am so sore. And not the kind of pain I enjoy. Maybe you can fix that later?"
- "Hey. Tonight, when you're done... you and me. I have an itch to scratch, and I don't want you being nice about it."
- "You. Me. Tonight. You're late? I make you pay."
- "Lua, save me, my feet hurt. Another long day. How're you?"
- "Nice to get away from the crowd sometimes, no?"
- "Sorry to be quiet today, corazón (heart) - the spiders are at it again."
- "Rough day? Want me to kiss it better? Or make it hurt better?"
- "You know the worst part about this shithole? Weak coffee. Pleegh."
- "From here, I can't hear Amir's arcade games. Do those things only say the same four lines?"
- "Man, you have so many fancy toys in here. And here I thought Quincy liked his guns."
- "Eleanor and I are talking now... like, really talking. Thanks to you, you know."
- "Today's a good day. Nobody's screaming. Nobody's bleeding. ...Yet."
- "Arthur looks like he's finally getting some sleep at night."
- "You, uh... think Aoi will finally take some time for herself, for a change?"
- "I think the two little boys are finally playing nice together. Good, because they were driving me up the walls."
- "You think Arthur and Aoi will ever get back together? I mean I hope not. They were shit for each other."
- "I am going to take a long, hot bath in a dark room... soak out these aches. If you want to join me, I won't say no."
- "So, what adventures have you been on today, my heart?"
- "Hey! Have you seen Neenah? She got off somewhere. Always getting into trouble, that one..."
- "Keep it quick, love. I have a headache that could kill a cow."
- "And what nonsense have you been up to, hmm?"
- "Ugh. Tell me something exciting. Hate being cooped up in this place…"
- "I think about everything will continue without us - your Xipe Totec, Entrati, Tau... but my story ends here. Never changing. Like this. With you. Could be worse."
- "Pssh, me? Oh, you know, wondering how long it'll be before Aoi accidentally crushes a gas tank and blows us all halfway to hell. Happy New Year."
- "Sometimes I wonder... why us? Why did that Entrati asshole pick us for this bullshit of all people? What did he know that we don't and how?!"
- "Hm... Do they have rats in the future? I mean, do you think they'd get along with my little muffins? Mm. Best not to find out. Don't need more mutants running around..."
- "Do you ever sit still? Blast in, blast out - blast in - blast out. You make me dizzy. Try walking once in a while, you're worse than Amir."

- "You know where I found Tláloc the other day? With Eleanor. Sitting on her lap, like they were talking. It... was the most peaceful I've ever seen the little bitey bastard. I think I have something to bond with the witch about, finally."
- "Ok, don't tell anybody but, I caught Arthur smiling and laughing at one of Quincy's jokes the other day. You have quite the effect on people, sunshine."
- "If somebody doesn't punch Entrati in the face for what he did to the Cavia, please find a way to let me be the one to do it."
- "It's nice to get a break from the civvies. With how they collect bullet holes from the Scaldra, you'd think it was their damn jobs."
- "Mm? Wondering what you would look like stretched out on a - (Laughs) don't get me excited. You look like you still have work to do."
- "Y'know, sometimes, I'm still surprised. My mom always said I'd die alone. Joke's on her, now I guess I won't die at all, huh."
- "Mmm. Who'd knew you'd be a sucker for punishment, huh? Can't say I'm complaining."
- "Being a ghost isn't so bad... if it means I get to haunt your cute ass for the rest of eternity, I suppose."
- "Never would've guessed we would wind up together... not in a million years. But, hey. I'm happy to be wrong once in a while."
- "And I couldn't be happier. Though... I do wonder... Can you loop us? How many tries did - nononono I don't want to know!"
- "Who knew being trapped forever in a shithole would wind up being one of the best parts of my life...?"
- "And so am I... and I wonder - do you want it hard or soft tonight? Mm? Your choice. I'll be nice."
- "A strange family - a strange life. I don't know if this is the heaven Lua planned for me, sunshine - but it's one I'm happy with."
- "What a family we make, no? You, me, my little muffins, the Hex, and that mutant freakin' cat that keeps - sorry. Heh. You're trying to be romantic."
- "Man, do you know how distracting you are? How hard it is for me not to just grab you by the wrist and - Finish your work. Find me later. Show me how happy you really are to be with me, yeah?"
- "Hey remember, some shit I can't patch up, ok?"
> New year is almost here and I am alone except for my bebecitos (little babies)
> You know where to find me
> Te amo, mi corazón (I love you, my heart)
- "Fine, I'll say it. I love you..."
- "I am your fantasma (ghost/phantom) - now and forever..."
- "This is one moment I hope never stops repeating..."
- "Happy New Year, sunshine, and all the ones to come..."
- "If she wasn't your blood, she'd be on her own out there."
- "We're in this mess because of you."
- "Amir, you said the nuke story made sense. This Y2K shit real?"
- "Maybe, we cut our losses like we should've done weeks ago. We pack up and get the hell out of this estercolero (dungheap) before it's turned to ash. Just an idea!"
- "Anyone still stuck here is Techrot anyway. Sometimes you have to amputate, Aoi. And cauterize."
- "I don't want more of that shit in my system!"
- "I start turning like Eleanor, I'll be haunting your ass."
- "See this is why the Major wears a freakin' face mask."
- "Even Scaldra got more sense than to come down here."
- "We'll still follow you, brave king. But this half-assed plan's gone full-guano. Amir's Y2K thing won't even work."
- "Off net. We'd have to 'full-on' the reactor and patch it direct. Only about four thousand Scaldra to the six of us. Bad odds güey."
- "Eleanor... Arthur, don't you dare. She's barely hanging on as it is."
- "I'm sorry we put you up to this."
- "Eleanor, hold here. I'll clear the gas."
- "Making sure that you are still... you."
- "Eleanor, hold here. I'll clear the gas."
- "Making sure that you are still... you."
- "Hey! After this we go for dinner."

- "You wanna clean rot, you're gonna get those pretty hands dirty. First, I run Amir's fancy little comp-sci project to force the Hell-Scrubbers to the surface. Next, I need you to keep 'em clean and for as long as you can. Got it?"

- "Today, the patient is Höllvania herself. She's choking on Techrot spores, and they're spreading. Scaldra built Hell-Scrubbers to purge the rot but those idiot niños (boys/children) couldn't keep them clean. Rot just absorbed them. I'm hoping you're a little better at your job. Find the first Scrubber."

- "Keeping this short and sweet. Go into the heart of the infestation. Recover the lost Hell-Scrubbers. Keep them clean. And when the timing is right, you fire them off and you kill the Techrot at source. The spores."
- "It's working. Hell-Scrubbers are starting to emerge. Gotta hand it to the little guy, he knows how to talk to the appliances."
- "Amir's code injection is like activated charcoal to the Techrot. Makes 'em puke these Hell-Scrubbers right back up."
- "I hear Scaldra want these things back, but not even Scaldra is willing to come down here with all this rot. Good thing you're not as smart as Scaldra. Now get to work."
- "Another Hell-Scrubber getting puked up… Although it's only puke if it comes out of the Techrot's… mouth… but that's not a mouth. Blghh."
- "One scrubber, side of spores, coming up."
- "Turns out it's not just Hell-Scrubbers coming out of the rot, there's some stuff we might be interested in. Like this. See, my ass is out here on the line too."
- "This might just make it all worth it."
- "I know it's not your birthday but… what more could a time traveler from the far distant future want?"
- "Sure, sometimes I get a little depressed, but then I remember that I get to scavenge for lost treasure in the festering pus of an overgrown cyst. So yeah…"
- "It's not my birthday, but I'll take it."
- "There's more where this came from. Just need time."
- "Hey, don't say I never did anything for you."
- "Hey, be on the lookout for SporeX Charges. Every little bit counts."
- "Crack enough Techrot and you're bound to find a few SporeX Charges. Perfect for emergencies."
- "Ain't that like a shot of adrenaline."
- "Levels dropping. That bought you some time."
- "These scrubbers are prone to spore growth. You don't shoot it off and it could become fatal. For the scrubber and you? Comprende? (Understand?)"
- "You know why they call them Hell-Scrubbers? 'Cause if you don't shoot off build-up fast enough you gonna learn what hell is like."
- "You gotta nurse these scrubbers. Keep 'em clean. Too much spore build-up and you got 'code white' on your hands."
- "Hey. You think I'm playing? Shoot that build-up off now!"
- "Need you to stay on top of those scrubbers. You see growth? Shoot it."
- "Hey! I need 20 cc's of fix your damn shit."
- "Now you get to do things the hard way."
- "Oh, hey... Welcome to the 'find out' phase."
- "Great. You lost a scrubber, but that's the least of your problems."
- "Sixty seconds to critical. Activate a scrubber, set off some SporeX, or get the hell out of there."
- "Spore contamination is getting out of hand. Start holding your breath!"
- "You got thirty seconds to pull through or I'm pulling you out."
- "Marking extraction. Use it when you need it, but only if you need it."
- "You've hit this mission's minimum threshold. But you didn't come down here to do the minimum, did you?"
- "Okay. Marking extraction. You can pull the ripcord whenever you need to. I won't judge."
- "I'm calling it. Nothing more you can do. Just get out."
- "Contamination is total. There's no saving it now. Get out while you can."
- "Man, they don't make PPE strong enough to handle what you're breathing in. Extract. Now."
- "Need medical support or just a friendly face?"
- "Hey, here to help. Got nothing better to do."
- "Me estaba haciendo güey (I wasn't doing anything (slang)). Where are we going?"
- "So we got a job or this just another joyride?"
- "We, uh, make a good team. A weird team, but, uh, a good team."
- "You brought nibbles for Vaquero, I hope."
- "Places to see, people to maim, people to patch back up."
- "We dance con (with) La Flaca again today, eh, friend?"
- "Another day, another whatever all this is."
- "Always good to see you. Well, me. Us. You get it."
- "Tell me we're going somewhere fun this time."
- "Multiplayer's more Amir's thing, but sure, let's roll."
- "Never a dull moment with you. Let's go."
- "Just don't do anything I wouldn't do, yeah? While you're me?"
- "Hola, mi vida (Hello, my life). Good to see you."
- "You okay? I will ruin them, just point me at 'em!"
- "What field of death are you bringing me to today, mi vida (my life)? So romantic."
- "Show me something grotesque and beautiful, corazón (heart)."
- "Miss me? Or do you just need stitches?"
- "Are you hurt? Do you wanna be?"
- "Heh. I'd rather be getting shot at with you than sharing space with Arthur's monstruosa sister."
- "I love that we can do this. Give it to me."
- "Hey, your heart beats with mine. Together we live or together we die."
- "Our bodies, our hearts, and our souls are one."
- "Let's show them what happens when they stand against us, corazón (heart)."
- "Hmm? Are we going on a date or a bloodbath? All the same to us, huh?"
- "You and me against the world. Bring it on."
- "Pleasure, pain. We feel the world together like this."
- "Hey, after this, we go for dinner. Te invito (I invite you/my treat)."
- "Okay, corazón (heart). I make for a fun date. Let's go."
- "You didn't have to make up excuses to see me, but I'm glad you did. Hola, bebé (Hey, babe)."
- "Eres buena onda (You're cool). You're always a good time, friend."
- "¿Hey, qué onda? ¿Cómo has estado? (Hey, what's up? How have you been?) How do we do?"
- "¿Qué onda (What's up), friend? We all good?"
- "¿Que onda, pinche güey? (What's up, fucking dude? (slang)) Enemy's feeling ballsy."
- "They won't be giving us any more trouble."
- "I'm down! Ándale (Move it), first minute's critical!"
- "Neta ahorita? (Really now? (slang)) You are getting me up right now!"
- "They got me. God damn it, I'm down."
- "Drop what you're doing and help me!"
- "En serio? (Really?) Really? You're just gonna stand there? Help me!"
- "They got me good, friend. Not gonna last long without an assist."
- "Get me up, get me up! I ain't done with these ojetes (assholes)!"
- "I'm hit... apurate güey (hurry up dude (slang)), get me up!"
- "No hay tos (No problem (slang)). Just winded. Let's go."
- "My hero, yeah? Next one's on me."
- "The close ones make you feel alive! Let's go."
- "I knew you wouldn't let me down."
- "Nobody hits me and gets away with it."
- "Must have thought they were pretty hot catching me like that."
- "Yo, what do you make of this?"
- "Oh, you want some chingadazos (beating (slang)), friend? Target marked."
- "Might wanna whack that one as a priority!"
- "Don't like the way this one's eyeballing me."
- "Yeah, let's go cause some property damage."
- "Whoo! Flyin' like I don't mind dyin'!"
- "Haha, chido (nice), this is more like it!"
- "Just don't crash. I don't want to have to set my own bones."
- "Yeah, betcha didn't even pack a medkit?"
- "Watch that Efervon! Shit's corrosive. Some scars I can't heal, you read me?"

path: Höllvania Central Mall 2024 Demo Idle Quotes
lines: - "Man, I've been awake so long the spiders in my head have all gone to sleep."
- "Never signed up for this. I'll be home, Mamá (Mom). Your little girl doesn't end here. No te preocupes (Don't worry)."

- "Being loved and being hurt, yeah I make no distinction. I knew someone, once, wired the same way. Kept me sane. And what of it? Te crees muy acá ¿no? (You think you're the big deal, huh?) Get outta my head, Eleanor."
- "Wacha (Look out): unless you're pissing blood right this second, whatever it is can wait."
- "I got nothin' to prove to you, Quincy! Go play your little games, niño (boy)."
- "I swear, should lock Aoi and Amir in a cuna (cradle/crib). Didn't sign up for no babysitting gig."
- "Yo, Aoi. Chill, hermana (sister). Do something for yourself, for once. Arthur ain't gonna blow away if you blink."
- "The boss says care for his sister I care for his sister. As long as you still are his sister... and as long as I feel like listening to him."
- "¿Qué onda? (What's up?) The Lady Eleanor ain't no more freaky than the last time you checked in. 'Less you know different?"
